component: Account Hub Exchange submission and native custom OAuth properties

quotes.text: Exchange tenant should be saved on the created account

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The Exchange form captures an optional custom OAuth object. Both the temporary verification server and final incoming-server creation call applyExchangeOAuthSettings. That helper requires the explicit custom flag and EWS/Graph type, then writes override, application ID and tenant through IExchangeIncomingServer. The new xpcshell tests directly assert those values for EWS; component Graph-state assertions do not prove Graph authentication or account creation. No OAuth request or account operation was executed in this study.
title: One helper applies custom Exchange OAuth details to verification and final creation
